data.credibility: Management frequently misses explicit financial targets, such as lowering FY26 revenue guidance to INR 3,626 crores against INR 4,500 crores and missing working capital goals. They also drop ambitious milestones like the $1 billion FY28 target quietly, showing mixed reliability in delivery.

lines.line: Promised INR 4,500 crores for FY26; delivered INR 3,626 crores, missing the revenue guidance.
OSAT facility delivered on track for commercial production by December 2025.
Multilayer HDI PCB plant operational readiness delayed from January 2026.
Promised sub-70 net working capital days for FY26; delivered 122 days, missing target.
Promised $1 billion revenue by fiscal 2028; dropped subsequently without further mention.
Promised PCB revenue of INR 300 to 400 crores in FY27; currently on track.
Promised OSAT revenue of INR 250 to 300 crores in FY27; currently on track.
Increase NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% contribution; pending future results.
Promised railway business growth of 20% to 25%; currently tracking at 40.6%.
Promised to turn cash positive by the end of the financial year; status is pending.
Promised revenue growth at twice the market growth rate; status is pending.
Incur capex of INR 300 crores for OSAT in FY27; status is pending.
Incur capex of INR 300 crores for PCB in FY27; status is pending.
Incur capex of INR 250 crores for EMS in FY27; status is pending.

bull: Revenue compounded at 53.9% annually over five years, reaching a TTM revenue of ₹3,899 cr with an order book of ₹83,663 Mn.
EBITDA margin widened from 10.0% in FY21 to 15.9% in FY26, accompanied by strong railway business growth of 40.6%.
Lightly geared balance sheet with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.19, backed by ₹4,748 cr net worth.
bear: Operating cash flow was negative over five years at -63% of reported profit, with negative cash flow in FY23, FY25, and FY26.
Working-capital days stretched significantly from 50 to 133 days over five years, missing the FY26 sub-70 target.
Growth is slowing, with three-year revenue compounding at 47.7% compared to 53.9% over five years, alongside missed FY26 revenue guidance.
